response.justification: Bogdan has strong backend and distributed-systems expertise with experience in event-driven architectures and microservices, including real-time systems at Dunnhumby. However, his direct experience with agentic AI systems, fintech infrastructure, or regulated environments is limited. His recent work at re:cinq involves AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks depth in production multi-agent systems or fintech-specific challenges like credit risk or liquidity optimization.
strengths: Strong distributed-systems expertise with event-driven architectures and microservices
Experience scaling engineering teams and implementing CI/CD practices
Proven ability to work across multiple stacks and languages, adapting to domain needs
concerns: Limited direct experience with agentic AI systems in production or fintech-specific applications
No documented experience with regulated financial environments or compliance infrastructure
Lacks hands-on experience with real-time credit risk, liquidity optimization, or trade decisioning
